contract.feature_gate: The Phased selector remains controlled by global.macro.phasedMacro; explicit loaded Phased documents still render locally.
contract.insertion: Palette clicks use activePhase; phase headers assign their destination phase; ordinary row drops inherit the previous defined phase or next defined phase, then stable-sort known phase rows.
contract.layout: Each section has a 1px top border and 50px header; rows are 42px; phase drop spaces have zero height; the trailing editor drop space remains 100px.
contract.launch: Launch overlay row offsets include visible phase headers and expanded phase rows.

remaining: The recorder/device service boundary remains unconnected; the phase record control only selects the phase and reports that boundary.
Runtime pointer capture, scrolling, tooltip clipping and rendered animation cannot be verified under repository constraints.
